note: PLT-02: symbol-version ceilings of the oldest supported target. Measured with readelf -V on the SailfishOS-5.1.0.11-aarch64 libc.so.6, libm.so.6 and libstdc++.so.6 (sfos-m1-sailtube and the official SDK target agree). An RPM requirement above a ceiling would raise the minimum OS without anyone noticing; tools/rpm_audit.py fails it. Raise a ceiling only together with the minimum OS (PLT-01).
